workflows.rationale: the merge job acts as the mingla-bundle-baseline GitHub App, minting an installation token with contents and pull-requests write that no other lane holds; this environment authority is confined to that one job and is never minted in the pull-request-triggered guard job sharing the file
owns the sole supabase/postgres service container for the executable SQL contract suites, provisioning one migrated cluster whose per-suite databases replace ten independent container boundaries

the nightly backup and restore drill is the sole production operation that reads the isolated Sites database and four private object buckets, uploads one encrypted independent recovery bundle, and provisions a PostgreSQL 17 service container for restore verification

posts and refreshes release-record and PR-link comments with issues and pull-requests write on the repository token, an authority no other lane holds, and runs on pull_request_target, status, workflow_run and issue_comment events that no existing lane listens to
